subject: general
question: Who was the teacher of Chandragupta Maurya?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Vishnu Gupta.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chanakya (Vishnu Gupta)** was the teacher of Chandragupta Maurya. 
 
• It was Chanakya who took **Chandragupta Maurya to the University of Taxila.**
 
• He is credited with the arrangment of the **first pan-Indian empire.**
 
• Chanakya played a main role in supporting Chandragupta bring down the strong **Nanda dynasty at Pataliputra, in the Magadha region.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5b58d097922d340d640458b7b1b47727a0fff025bac50589debb389b28daafc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kalhana was the writer** of Rajatarangini (River of Kings), an account of the history of Kashmir**.​ 
 
• Vishnu Sharma was the writer** of this anthropomorphic political treatise known as Panchatantra**.
 
• Skandgupta was **a Gupta Emperor of India**.
